tomā-dum̐hā dekhite mora im̐hā āgamana
you two to see My here coming

212I had no reason to come near Gauḍa; I came here only to see you two.

এই মোর মনের কথা কেহ নাহি জানে ৷
সবে বলে, কেনে আইলা রামকেলি-গ্রামে ॥ ২১৩ ॥

ei mora manera kathā keha nāhi jāne
this of My heart the matter anyone not knows
sabe bale, kene āilā rāmakeli-grāme
all say why has He come to the village of Rāmakeli

213No one knows the secret of My heart; everyone asks why I have come to Rāmakeli.

ভাল হৈল, দুই ভাই আইলা মোর স্থানে ৷
ঘরে যাহ, ভয় কিছু না করিহ মনে ॥ ২১৪ ॥

bhāla haila, dui bhāi āilā mora sthāne
good it was the two brothers came My to the place
ghare yāha, bhaya kichu nā kariha mane
home go fear any not keep in the mind

214It is good that you two brothers came to Me. Now go home and do not be afraid.

জন্মে জন্মে তুমি দুই — কিঙ্কর আমার ৷
অচিরাতে কৃষ্ণ তোমায় করিবে উদ্ধার ॥ ২১৫ ॥

janme janme tumi dui — kiṅkara āmāra
in birth after birth you two servants Mine
acirāte kṛṣṇa tomāya karibe uddhāra
very soon Kṛṣṇa you will make deliverance

215Birth after birth you two are My servants. Very soon Kṛṣṇa will deliver you.”

এত বলি দুঁহার শিরে ধরিল দুই হাতে ৷
দুই ভাই ধরি’ প্রভুর পদ নিল মাথে ॥ ২১৬ ॥

eta bali dum̐hāra śire dharila dui hāte
thus saying of both on the heads He placed two hands
dui bhāi dhari’ prabhura pada nila māthe
the two brothers taking the Lord’s feet placed on their heads

216Saying this, He placed His two hands on their heads, and the two brothers took the Lord’s feet and set them on their heads.

দোঁহা আলিঙ্গিয়া প্রভু বলিল ভক্তগণে ৷
সবে কৃপা করি’ উদ্ধার’ এই দুই জনে ॥ ২১৭ ॥

dom̐hā āliṅgiyā prabhu balila bhakta-gaṇe
both embracing the Lord said to the devotees
sabe kṛpā kari’ uddhāra’ ei dui jane
all mercy showing deliver these two persons

217Embracing them both, the Lord said to the devotees: “All of you, be merciful and deliver these two.”

দুই জনে প্রভুর কৃপা দেখি’ ভক্তগণে ৷
‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ বলে সবে আনন্দিত-মনে ॥ ২১৮ ॥

dui jane prabhura kṛpā dekhi’ bhakta-gaṇe
to the two persons the Lord’s mercy seeing the devotees
‘hari’ ‘hari’ bale sabe ānandita-mane
Hari Hari call all with joyful hearts

218Seeing the Lord’s mercy on the two, all the devotees joyfully called out, “Hari! Hari!”

নিত্যানন্দ, হরিদাস, শ্রীবাস, গদাধর ৷
মুকুন্দ, জগদানন্দ, মুরারি, বক্রেশ্বর ॥ ২১৯ ॥

nityānanda, haridāsa, śrīvāsa, gadādhara
Nityānanda Haridāsa Śrīvāsa Gadādhara
mukunda, jagadānanda, murāri, vakreśvara
Mukunda Jagadānanda Murāri Vakreśvara

219Nityānanda, Haridāsa, Śrīvāsa, Gadādhara, Mukunda, Jagadānanda, Murāri and Vakreśvara were there.

সবার চরণে ধরি’ পড়ে দুই ভাই ৷
সবে বলে, — ধন্য তুমি, পাইলে গোসাঞি ॥ ২২০ ॥

sabāra caraṇe dhari’ paḍe dui bhāi
of all the feet clasping fall the two brothers
sabe bale, — dhanya tumi, pāile gosāñi
all say blessed you are you have attained the Gosāñi

220The two brothers fell at the feet of each of them, and all said: “You are blessed — you have attained the Lord.”

সবা-পাশ আজ্ঞা মাগি’ চলন-সময় ৷
প্রভু-পদে কহে কিছু করিয়া বিনয় ॥ ২২১ ॥

sabā-pāśa ājñā māgi’ calana-samaya
from all permission asking at the time of leaving
prabhu-pade kahe kichu kariyā vinaya
at the Lord’s feet they say something showing humility

221Asking leave of everyone, at the time of departure they bowed at the Lord’s feet and humbly said:44

ইঁহা হৈতে চল, প্রভু, ইঁহা নাহি কাজ ৷
যদ্যপি তোমারে ভক্তি করে গৌড়রাজ ॥ ২২২ ॥

im̐hā haite cala, prabhu, im̐hā nāhi kāja
here from go O Lord here there is no business
yadyapi tomāre bhakti kare gauḍa-rāja
although You devotion shows the king of Gauḍa

222“Leave this place, O Lord; there is nothing for You here. True, the king of Gauḍa shows You devotion.

তথাপি যবনজাতি, না করিহ প্রতীতি ৷
তীর্থযাত্রায় এত সংঘট্ট ভাল নহে রীতি ॥ ২২৩ ॥

tathāpi yavana jāti, nā kariha pratīti
still a Muslim by birth not do trust
tīrtha-yātrāya eta saṅghaṭṭa bhāla nahe rīti
on pilgrimage such a crowd good is not the custom

223Yet he is a Muslim by birth — do not trust him. And such a crowd is not the proper way to go on pilgrimage.

যাঁহা সঙ্গে চলে এই লোক লক্ষকোটি ৷
বৃন্দাবন যাইবার এ নহে পরিপাটী ॥ ২২৪ ॥

yām̐hā saṅge cale ei loka lakṣa-koṭi
with whom together go these people in hundreds of thousands
vṛndāvana yāivāra e nahe paripāṭī
to Vṛndāvana for going this is not the proper manner

224To travel to Vṛndāvana followed by hundreds of thousands of people is not fitting.”

যদ্যপি বস্তুতঃ প্রভুর কিছু নাহি ভয় ৷
তথাপি লৌকিকলীলা, লোক-চেষ্টাময় ॥ ২২৫ ॥

yadyapi vastutaḥ prabhura kichu nāhi bhaya
although in truth of the Lord any there is no fear
tathāpi laukika-līlā, loka-ceṣṭā-maya
still a worldly pastime of human behaviour full

225Although in truth the Lord has nothing to fear, His pastimes in this world follow the ways of ordinary people.45

এত বলি’ চরণ বন্দি’ গেলা দুইজন ৷
প্রভুর সেই গ্রাম হৈতে চলিতে হৈল মন ॥ ২২৬ ॥

eta bali’ caraṇa vandi’ gelā dui-jana
thus saying His feet saluting went the two
prabhura sei grāma haite calite haila mana
of the Lord that village from to leave arose the mind

226Saying this, the two saluted His feet and left, and the Lord resolved to leave that village.

প্রাতে চলি’ আইলা প্রভু ‘কানাইর নাটশালা’ ৷
দেখিল সকল তাঁহা কৃষ্ণচরিত্র-লীলা ॥ ২২৭ ॥

prāte cali’ āilā prabhu ‘kānāira nāṭaśālā’
in the morning setting out came the Lord to Kānāi’s Nāṭaśālā
dekhila sakala tām̐hā kṛṣṇa-caritra-līlā
He saw all there of Kṛṣṇa’s deeds the pastimes

227Setting out in the morning, the Lord came to Kānāi’s Nāṭaśālā, and there He saw depicted all the pastimes of Kṛṣṇa.46

সেই রাত্রে প্রভু তাঁহা চিন্তে মনে মন ৷
সঙ্গে সংঘট্ট ভাল নহে, বলে সনাতন ॥ ২২৮ ॥

sei rātre prabhu tām̐hā cinte mane mana
that night the Lord there ponders in His mind within
saṅge saṅghaṭṭa bhāla nahe, bale sanātana
with Him a crowd good is not says Sanātana

228That night the Lord pondered within Himself: “Sanātana says it is not good to travel with a crowd.

মথুরা যাইব আমি এত লোক-সঙ্গে ৷
কিছু সুখ না হইবে, হবে রসভঙ্গে ॥ ২২৯ ॥

mathurā yāiba āmi eta loka-saṅge
to Mathurā will go I so many with people
kichu sukha nā haibe, habe rasa-bhaṅge
any happiness not there will be there will be a break of rasa

229If I go to Mathurā with so many people, there will be no happiness in it; the rasa will be spoiled.

একাকী যাইব, কিম্বা সঙ্গে একজন ৷
তবে সে শোভয়ে বৃন্দাবনেরে গমন ॥ ২৩০ ॥

ekākī yāiba, kimbā saṅge eka jana
alone I will go or with Me one person
tabe se śobhaye vṛndāvanere gamana
then only becomes beautiful to Vṛndāvana the journey

230I shall go alone, or with just one companion; only then will My journey to Vṛndāvana be beautiful.”

এত চিন্তি’ প্রাতঃকালে গঙ্গাস্নান করি’ ৷
‘নীলাচলে যাব’ বলি’ চলিলা গৌরহরি ॥ ২৩১ ॥

eta cinti’ prātaḥ-kāle gaṅgā-snāna kari’
thus thinking in the morning in the Gaṅgā a bath taking
‘nīlācale yāba’ bali’ calilā gaurahari
to Nīlācala I will go saying set out Gaurahari

231Thinking this, Gaurahari bathed in the Gaṅgā in the morning and set out, saying, “I shall go to Nīlācala.”

এই মত চলি’ চলি’ আইলা শান্তিপুরে ৷
দিন পাঁচ-সাত রহিলা আচার্য্যের ঘরে ॥ ২৩২ ॥

ei mata cali’ cali’ āilā śāntipure
in this way walking walking He came to Śāntipura
dina pām̐ca-sāta rahilā ācāryera ghare
days five or seven He stayed of the Ācārya at the house

232Walking on in this way He came to Śāntipura and stayed five or seven days at the Ācārya’s house.

শচীদেবী আসি’ তাঁরে কৈল নমস্কার ৷
সাত দিন তাঁর ঠাঞি ভিক্ষা-ব্যবহার ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

śacī-devī āsi’ tām̐re kaila namaskāra
Śacīdevī coming to Him made obeisance
sāta dina tām̐ra ṭhāñi bhikṣā-vyavahāra
seven days her at the place the taking of meals

233Śacīdevī came and offered Him her obeisance, and for seven days He took His meals from her.

তাঁর আজ্ঞা লঞা পুনঃ করিলা গমনে ৷
বিনয় করিয়া বিদায় দিল ভক্তগণে ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

tām̐ra ājñā lañā punaḥ karilā gamane
her permission taking again He made the journey
vinaya kariyā vidāya dila bhakta-gaṇe
humility showing leave gave to the devotees

234Taking her permission, He set out again, and He humbly bade the devotees farewell:47

জনা দুই সঙ্গে আমি যাব নীলাচলে ৷
আমারে মিলিবা আসি’ রথযাত্রা-কালে ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

janā dui saṅge āmi yāba nīlācale
persons two with Me I will go to Nīlācala
āmāre milibā āsi’ ratha-yātrā-kāle
Me you will meet coming at the time of the Ratha-yātrā

235“I shall go to Nīlācala with two companions. Come and meet Me at the time of the Ratha-yātrā.”

বলভদ্র ভট্টাচার্য্য, আর পণ্ডিত দামোদর ৷
দুইজন-সঙ্গে প্রভু আইলা নীলাচল ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

balabhadra bhaṭṭācārya, āra paṇḍita dāmodara
Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya and Paṇḍita Dāmodara
dui-jana-saṅge prabhu āilā nīlācala
with the two persons the Lord came to Nīlācala

236With two companions — Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya and Dāmodara Paṇḍita — the Lord came to Nīlācala.

দিন কত রহি’ তাঁহা চলিলা বৃন্দাবন ৷
লুকাঞা চলিলা রাত্রে, না জানে কোন জন ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

dina kata rahi’ tām̐hā calilā vṛndāvana
days a few staying there He set out for Vṛndāvana
lukāñā calilā rātre, nā jāne kona jana
secretly He went at night not knows any person

237After staying there a few days He set out for Vṛndāvana, leaving secretly at night without anyone knowing.

বলভদ্র ভট্টাচার্য্য রহে মাত্র সঙ্গে ৷
ঝারিখণ্ড-পথে কাশী আইলা নানারঙ্গে ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

balabhadra bhaṭṭācārya rahe mātra saṅge
Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya remains only with Him
jhārikhaṇḍa-pathe kāśī āilā nānā-raṅge
by the Jhārikhaṇḍa road to Kāśī He came in many delights

238Only Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya stayed with Him. By the forest road of Jhārikhaṇḍa He came to Kāśī, enjoying many wonderful pastimes on the way.

দিন চারি কাশীতে রহি’ গেলা বৃন্দাবন ৷
মথুরা দেখিয়া দেখে দ্বাদশ কানন ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

dina cāri kāśīte rahi’ gelā vṛndāvana
days four in Kāśī staying He went to Vṛndāvana
mathurā dekhiyā dekhe dvādaśa kānana
Mathurā seeing He sees twelve forests

239After staying four days in Kāśī He went to Vṛndāvana; having seen Mathurā, He visited the twelve forests.48

লীলাস্থল দেখি’ প্রেমে হইলা অস্থির ৷
বলভদ্র কৈল তাঁরে মথুরার বাহির ॥ ২৪০ ॥

līlā-sthala dekhi’ preme ha-ilā asthira
the places of the pastimes seeing in love He became restless
balabhadra kaila tām̐re mathurāra bāhira
Balabhadra brought Him of Mathurā outside

240Seeing the places of the pastimes, He became overwhelmed with love, and Balabhadra led Him away from Mathurā.

গঙ্গাতীর-পথে লঞা প্রয়াগে আইলা ৷
শ্রীরূপ প্রভুরে আসি’ তথাই মিলিলা ॥ ২৪১ ॥

gaṅgā-tīra-pathe lañā prayāge āilā
by the road along the Gaṅgā taking to Prayāga he came
śrī-rūpa prabhure āsi’ tathāi mililā
Śrī Rūpa the Lord coming right there met

241Taking Him along the road beside the Gaṅgā, Balabhadra came to Prayāga, and there Śrī Rūpa came and met the Lord.

দণ্ডবৎ করি’ রূপ ভূমিতে পড়িলা ৷
পরম আনন্দে প্রভু আলিঙ্গন দিলা ॥ ২৪২ ॥

daṇḍavat kari’ rūpa bhūmite paḍilā
obeisance making Rūpa on the ground fell
parama ānande prabhu āliṅgana dilā
in supreme joy the Lord an embrace gave

242Rūpa fell to the ground in obeisance, and the Lord embraced him in supreme joy.

শ্রীরূপে শিক্ষা করাই’ পাঠা’ন বৃন্দাবন ৷
আপনে করিলা বারাণসী আগমন ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

śrī-rūpe śikṣā karāi’ pāṭhā’na vṛndāvana
Śrī Rūpa instruction giving sends to Vṛndāvana
āpane karilā vārāṇasī āgamana
Himself made to Vārāṇasī coming

243Having instructed Śrī Rūpa, He sent him to Vṛndāvana, and He Himself came to Vārāṇasī.

কাশীতে প্রভুকে আসি’ মিলিলা সনাতন ৷
দুই মাস রহি’ তাঁরে করাইল শিক্ষণ ॥ ২৪৪ ॥

kāśīte prabhuke āsi’ mililā sanātana
in Kāśī the Lord coming met Sanātana
dui māsa rahi’ tām̐re karāila śikṣaṇa
two months staying him He gave instruction

244In Kāśī Sanātana came and met the Lord, who stayed two months and instructed him.

মথুরা পাঠাইলা তাঁরে দিয়া ভক্তিবল ৷
সন্ন্যাসীরে কৃপা করি’ গেলা নীলাচল ॥ ২৪৫ ॥

mathurā pāṭhāilā tām̐re diyā bhakti-bala
to Mathurā He sent him giving the strength of bhakti
sannyāsīre kṛpā kari’ gelā nīlācala
to the sannyāsī mercy showing He went to Nīlācala

245He sent him to Mathurā, investing him with the strength of bhakti; then, after showing mercy to the sannyāsī, He went to Nīlācala.49

ছয় বৎসর প্রভু ঐছে করিলা বিলাস ৷
কভু ইতি-উতি গতি, কভু ক্ষেত্রবাস ॥ ২৪৬ ॥

chaya vatsara prabhu aiche karilā vilāsa
six years the Lord thus enjoyed pastimes
kabhu iti-uti gati, kabhu kṣetra-vāsa
sometimes here and there wandering sometimes dwelling in the Kṣetra

246For six years the Lord enjoyed such pastimes, sometimes wandering here and there, sometimes living in the Kṣetra (Purī).

আনন্দে ভক্ত-সঙ্গে সদা কীর্ত্তন-বিলাস ৷
জগন্নাথ-দরশন, প্রেমের বিলাস ॥ ২৪৭ ॥

ānande bhakta-saṅge sadā kīrtana-vilāsa
in joy with the devotees always pastimes of kīrtana
jagannātha-daraśana, premera vilāsa
seeing Jagannātha of love the pastimes

247With the devotees He always delighted in kīrtana, beheld Jagannātha and revelled in love.

মধ্যলীলার কৈলুঁ এই সূত্র-বিবরণ ৷
অন্ত্যলীলার সূত্র এবে শুন, ভক্তগণ ॥ ২৪৮ ॥

madhya-līlāra kailum̐ ei sūtra-vivaraṇa
of the Madhya-līlā I have made this summary in sūtras
antya-līlāra sūtra ebe śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
of the Antya-līlā the sūtras now hear O devotees

248Thus I have given the Madhya-līlā in brief sūtras. Now, O devotees, hear the sūtras of the Antya-līlā.

বৃন্দাবন হৈতে যদি নীলাচলে আইলা ৷
আঠার বর্ষ তাঁহা বাস, কাঁহা নাহি গেলা ॥ ২৪৯ ॥

vṛndāvana haite yadi nīlācale āilā
Vṛndāvana from when to Nīlācala He came
āṭhāra varṣa tām̐hā vāsa, kām̐hā nāhi gelā
eighteen years there dwelling anywhere not went

249After He returned from Vṛndāvana to Nīlācala, He lived there eighteen years and went nowhere else.50

প্রতিবর্ষ আইসেন তাঁহা গৌড়ের ভক্তগণ ৷
চারি মাস রহে প্রভুর সঙ্গে সম্মিলন ॥ ২৫০ ॥

prativarṣa āisena tām̐hā gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa
every year come there of Gauḍa the devotees
cāri māsa rahe prabhura saṅge sammilana
four months last with the Lord together the meeting

250Every year the devotees of Gauḍa came there and stayed four months in the Lord’s company.

নিরন্তর নৃত্যগীত কীর্ত্তন-বিলাস ৷
আ-চণ্ডালে প্রেমভক্তি করিলা প্রকাশ ॥ ২৫১ ॥

nirantara nṛtya-gīta kīrtana-vilāsa
constantly dancing and singing pastimes of kīrtana
ā-caṇḍāle prema-bhakti karilā prakāśa
down to the caṇḍāla loving devotion He made manifest

251Constantly He sang and danced in the joy of kīrtana, and revealed loving devotion (prema-bhakti) to all, even to the caṇḍālas.

পণ্ডিত-গোসাঞি কৈল নীলাচলে বাস ৷
বক্রেশ্বর, দামোদর, শঙ্কর, হরিদাস ॥ ২৫২ ॥

paṇḍita-gosāñi kaila nīlācale vāsa
the Paṇḍita Gosāñi made in Nīlācala residence
vakreśvara, dāmodara, śaṅkara, haridāsa
Vakreśvara Dāmodara Śaṅkara Haridāsa

252Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi lived in Nīlācala, as did Vakreśvara, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara and Haridāsa.51

জগদানন্দ, ভবানন্দ, গোবিন্দ, কাশীশ্বর ৷
পরমানন্দপুরী, আর স্বরূপ-দামোদর ॥ ২৫৩ ॥

jagadānanda, bhavānanda, govinda, kāśīśvara
Jagadānanda Bhavānanda Govinda Kāśīśvara
paramānanda-purī, āra svarūpa-dāmodara
Paramānanda Purī and Svarūpa Dāmodara

253Jagadānanda, Bhavānanda, Govinda, Kāśīśvara, Paramānanda Purī and Svarūpa Dāmodara lived there too.52

ক্ষেত্রবাসী রামানন্দ রায় প্রভৃতি ৷
প্রভুসঙ্গে এই সব কৈল নিত্য স্থিতি ॥ ২৫৪ ॥

kṣetra-vāsī rāmānanda rāya prabhṛti
residents of the Kṣetra Rāmānanda Rāya and others
prabhu-saṅge ei saba kaila nitya sthiti
with the Lord these all made constant stay

254Rāmānanda Rāya and the other residents of the Kṣetra all remained constantly with the Lord.

অদ্বৈত, নিত্যানন্দ, মুকুন্দ, শ্রীবাস ৷
বিদ্যানিধি, বাসুদেব, মুরারি, — যত দাস ॥ ২৫৫ ॥

প্রতিবর্ষে আইসে সঙ্গে, রহে চারিমাস ৷
তাঁ-সবা লঞা প্রভুর বিবিধ বিলাস ॥ ২৫৬ ॥

advaita, nityānanda, mukunda, śrīvāsa
Advaita Nityānanda Mukunda Śrīvāsa
vidyānidhi, vāsudeva, murāri, — yata dāsa
Vidyānidhi Vāsudeva Murāri all the servants
prativarṣe āise saṅge, rahe cāri-māsa
every year come together stay four months
tām̐-sabā lañā prabhura vividha vilāsa
them all taking the Lord’s various pastimes

255–256Advaita, Nityānanda, Mukunda, Śrīvāsa, Vidyānidhi, Vāsudeva, Murāri and all His other servants came together every year and stayed four months, and with them the Lord enjoyed many kinds of pastimes.

হরিদাসের সিদ্ধিপ্রাপ্তি, — অদ্ভুত সে সব ৷
আপনি মহাপ্রভু যাঁর কৈল মহোৎসব ॥ ২৫৭ ॥

haridāsera siddhi-prāpti, — adbhuta se saba
of Haridāsa the attainment of perfection wonderful that all
āpani mahāprabhu yām̐ra kaila mahotsava
Himself Mahāprabhu whose held great festival

257Haridāsa’s attainment of perfection was wonderful in every way, and Mahāprabhu Himself held a great festival in his honour.53

তবে রূপ-গোসাঞির পুনরাগমন ৷
তাঁহার হৃদয়ে কৈল প্রভু শক্তি-সঞ্চারণ ॥ ২৫৮ ॥

tabe rūpa-gosāñira punar-āgamana
then of Rūpa Gosāñi the return
tām̐hāra hṛdaye kaila prabhu śakti-sañcāraṇa
his in the heart made the Lord the infusion of power

258Then Rūpa Gosāñi came again, and the Lord infused His power into his heart.54

তবে ছোট হরিদাসে প্রভু কৈল দণ্ড ৷
দামোদর-পণ্ডিত কৈল প্রভুকে বাক্য-দণ্ড ॥ ২৫৯ ॥

tabe choṭa haridāse prabhu kaila daṇḍa
then Choṭa Haridāsa the Lord gave punishment
dāmodara-paṇḍita kaila prabhuke vākya-daṇḍa
Dāmodara Paṇḍita gave to the Lord punishment by words

259Then the Lord punished Choṭa Haridāsa, and Dāmodara Paṇḍita “punished” the Lord with words.55

তবে সনাতন-গোসাঞির পুনরাগমন ৷
জ্যৈষ্ঠমাসে প্রভু তাঁরে কৈল পরীক্ষণ ॥ ২৬০ ॥

tabe sanātana-gosāñira punar-āgamana
then of Sanātana Gosāñi the return
jyaiṣṭha-māse prabhu tām̐re kaila parīkṣaṇa
in the month of Jyaiṣṭha the Lord him made a test

260Then Sanātana Gosāñi came again, and in the month of Jyaiṣṭha the Lord tested him.

তুষ্ট হঞা প্রভু তাঁরে পাঠাইলা বৃন্দাবন ৷
অদ্বৈতের হস্তে প্রভুর অদ্ভুত ভোজন ॥ ২৬১ ॥

tuṣṭa hañā prabhu tām̐re pāṭhāilā vṛndāvana
pleased being the Lord him sent to Vṛndāvana
advaitera haste prabhura adbhuta bhojana
from Advaita’s hand the Lord’s wonderful meal

261Pleased with him, the Lord sent him to Vṛndāvana. Then came the Lord’s wonderful meal from Advaita’s own hand.

নিত্যানন্দ-সঙ্গে যুক্তি করিয়া নিভৃতে ৷
তাঁরে পাঠাইলা গৌড়ে প্রেম প্রচারিতে ॥ ২৬২ ॥

nityānanda-saṅge yukti kariyā nibhṛte
with Nityānanda counsel taking in private
tām̐re pāṭhāilā gauḍe prema pracārite
Him He sent to Gauḍa prema to preach

262After consulting Nityānanda in private, He sent Him to Gauḍa to preach prema.

তবে ত’ বল্লভ ভট্ট প্রভুরে মিলিলা ৷
কৃষ্ণনামের অর্থ প্রভু তাঁহারে কহিলা ॥ ২৬৩ ॥

tabe ta’ vallabha bhaṭṭa prabhure mililā
then indeed Vallabha Bhaṭṭa the Lord met
kṛṣṇa-nāmera artha prabhu tām̐hāre kahilā
of Kṛṣṇa’s name the meaning the Lord to him told

263Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa met the Lord, and the Lord explained to him the meaning of Kṛṣṇa’s name.

প্রদ্যুম্ন মিশ্রেরে প্রভু রামানন্দ-স্থানে ৷
কৃষ্ণকথা শুনাইল কহি’ তাঁর গুণে ॥ ২৬৪ ॥

pradyumna miśrere prabhu rāmānanda-sthāne
Pradyumna Miśra the Lord at Rāmānanda’s place
kṛṣṇa-kathā śunāila kahi’ tām̐ra guṇe
Kṛṣṇa-kathā made him hear telling his qualities

264Telling Pradyumna Miśra of Rāmānanda’s qualities, the Lord had him hear talks about Kṛṣṇa from Rāmānanda.56

গোপীনাথ পট্টনায়ক — রামানন্দ-ভ্রাতা ৷
রাজা মারিতেছিল, প্রভু হৈল ত্রাতা ॥ ২৬৫ ॥

gopīnātha paṭṭanāyaka — rāmānanda-bhrātā
Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka Rāmānanda’s brother
rājā māritechila, prabhu haila trātā
the king was about to kill the Lord became the savior

265Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, Rāmānanda’s brother, was about to be put to death by the king, and the Lord became his saviour.

রামচন্দ্রপুরী-ভয়ে ভিক্ষা ঘাটাইল ৷
বৈষ্ণবের দুঃখ দেখি’ অর্দ্ধেক রাখিল ॥ ২৬৬ ॥

rāmacandra-purī-bhaye bhikṣā ghāṭāila
for fear of Rāmacandra Purī His food He reduced
vaiṣṇavera duḥkha dekhi’ ardheka rākhila
of the Vaiṣṇavas the sorrow seeing half He kept

266For fear of Rāmacandra Purī He cut down His meals, but seeing the Vaiṣṇavas’ sorrow He kept to half His former portion.

ব্রহ্মাণ্ড-ভিতরে হয় চৌদ্দ ভুবন ৷
চৌদ্দভুবনে বৈসে যত জীবগণ ॥ ২৬৭ ॥

brahmāṇḍa-bhitare haya caudda bhuvana
of the universe within are fourteen worlds
caudda-bhuvane vaise yata jīva-gaṇa
in the fourteen worlds dwell all living beings

267Within the universe are fourteen worlds, and in them dwell countless living beings.57

মনুষ্যের বেশ ধরি’ যাত্রিকের ছলে ৷
প্রভুর দর্শন করে আসি’ নীলাচলে ॥ ২৬৮ ॥

manuṣyera veśa dhari’ yātrikera chale
human form assuming of pilgrims in the guise
prabhura darśana kare āsi’ nīlācale
the Lord’s sight have coming to Nīlācala

268All of them took human form and came to Nīlācala in the guise of pilgrims to see the Lord.

একদিন শ্রীবাসাদি যত ভক্তগণ ৷
মহাপ্রভুর গুণ গাঞা করেন কীর্ত্তন ॥ ২৬৯ ॥

eka dina śrīvāsādi yata bhakta-gaṇa
one day Śrīvāsa and others all the devotees
mahāprabhura guṇa gāñā karena kīrtana
of Mahāprabhu the qualities singing perform kīrtana

269One day Śrīvāsa and all the other devotees held kīrtana, singing of Mahāprabhu’s qualities.

শুনি’ ভক্তগণে কহে সক্রোধ বচনে ৷
“কৃষ্ণ-নাম-গুণ ছাড়ি’ কি কর কীর্ত্তনে ॥ ২৭০ ॥

śuni’ bhakta-gaṇe kahe sa-krodha vacane
hearing to the devotees He says angry in words
kṛṣṇa-nāma-guṇa chāḍi’ ki kara kīrtane
Kṛṣṇa’s name and qualities leaving aside what do you do in kīrtana

270Hearing this, the Lord spoke to the devotees in angry words: “Leaving aside Kṛṣṇa’s names and qualities, what are you singing in your kīrtana?58

ঔদ্ধত্য করিতে হৈল সবাকার মন ৷
স্বতন্ত্র হইয়া সবে নাশা’বে ভুবন ॥” ॥ ২৭১ ॥

auddhatya karite haila sabākāra mana
insolence to do has become of all the mind
svatantra ha-iyā sabe nāśā’be bhuvana
independent becoming all you will ruin the world

271All of you have set your minds on insolence; acting independently, you will ruin the world!”

দশদিকে কোটি কোটি লোক হেন কালে ৷
‘জয় কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য’ বলি’ করে কোলাহলে ॥ ২৭২ ॥

daśa-dike koṭi koṭi loka hena kāle
in the ten directions millions upon millions people at that time
‘jaya kṛṣṇa-caitanya’ bali’ kare kolāhale
glory to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya saying make a tumult

272At that very time millions upon millions of people on all sides raised a tumult, crying, “Glory to Kṛṣṇa Caitanya!

জয় জয় মহাপ্রভু — ব্রজেন্দ্রকুমার ৷
জগৎ তারিতে প্রভু, তোমার অবতার ॥ ২৭৩ ॥

jaya jaya mahāprabhu — vrajendra-kumāra
glory glory to Mahāprabhu the son of the king of Vraja
jagat tārite prabhu, tomāra avatāra
the world to deliver O Lord Your descent

273Glory, glory to Mahāprabhu, the son of the king of Vraja! O Lord, You have descended to deliver the world.

বহুদূর হৈতে আইনু হঞা বড় আর্ত্ত ৷
দরশন দিয়া প্রভু করহ কৃতার্থ ॥ ২৭৪ ॥

bahu-dūra haite āinu hañā baḍa ārta
from far away from we have come being very distressed
daraśana diyā prabhu karaha kṛtārtha
sight giving O Lord make us fulfilled

274We have come from very far away in great distress. O Lord, grant us Your sight and fulfil our lives!”

শুনিয়া লোকের দৈন্য দ্রবিলা হৃদয় ৷
বাহিরে আসি’ দরশন দিলা দয়াময় ॥ ২৭৫ ॥

śuniyā lokera dainya dravilā hṛdaya
hearing of the people the humility melted His heart
bāhire āsi’ daraśana dilā dayā-maya
outside coming sight gave the merciful Lord

275Hearing the people’s humble plea, the merciful Lord’s heart melted; He came outside and let them see Him.

বাহু তুলি’ বলে প্রভু, — বল, ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ ৷
উঠিল শ্রীহরিধ্বনি চতুর্দ্দিক্ ভরি’ ॥ ২৭৬ ॥

bāhu tuli’ bale prabhu, — bala, ‘hari’ ‘hari’
arms raising says the Lord say Hari Hari
uṭhila śrī-hari-dhvani catur-dik bhari’
arose the sound of Śrī Hari the four directions filling

276Raising His arms, the Lord said, “Say ‘Hari! Hari!’” — and the sound of Śrī Hari’s name arose, filling all four directions.

প্রভু দেখি’ প্রেমে লোক আনন্দিত মন ৷
প্রভুকে ঈশ্বর বলি’ করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ২৭৭ ॥

prabhu dekhi’ preme loka ānandita mana
the Lord seeing in love the people joyful at heart
prabhuke īśvara bali’ karaye stavana
the Lord God calling they offer praise

277Seeing the Lord, the people were filled with love and joy; calling Him God, they offered Him praise.

স্তব শুনি’ প্রভুকে কহেন শ্রীনিবাস ৷
“ঘরে গুপ্ত হও, কেনে বাহিরে প্রকাশ ॥ ২৭৮ ॥

stava śuni’ prabhuke kahena śrīnivāsa
the praise hearing to the Lord says Śrīnivāsa
ghare gupta hao, kene bāhire prakāśa
at home hidden You are why outside revealed

278Hearing their praise, Śrīnivāsa said to the Lord: “At home You stay hidden — why reveal Yourself outside?

কে শিখাল এই লোকে, কহে কোন্ বাত ৷
ইহা-সবার মুখ ঢাক দিয়া নিজ হাত ॥ ২৭৯ ॥

ke śikhāla ei loke, kahe kon bāta
who taught these people they say what words
ihā-sabāra mukha ḍhāka diyā nija hāta
of all these the mouths cover giving Your own hand

279Who taught these people? What are they saying? Cover all their mouths with Your own hand!

সূর্য্য যেন উদয় করি’ চাহে লুকাইতে ৷
বুঝিতে না পারি তোমার ঐছন চরিতে” ॥ ২৮০ ॥

sūrya yena udaya kari’ cāhe lukāite
the sun as if rising having done wishes to hide
bujhite nā pāri tomāra aichana carite
to understand not we can Your such conduct

280It is as if the sun, having risen, wished to hide. We cannot understand such behaviour of Yours.”

প্রভু কহেন, — শ্রীনিবাস, ছাড় বিড়ম্বনা ৷
সবে মেলি’ কর মোরে কতেক লাঞ্ছনা ॥ ২৮১ ॥

prabhu kahena, — śrīnivāsa, chāḍa viḍambanā
the Lord says Śrīnivāsa give up mockery
sabe meli’ kara more kateka lāñchanā
all together you make Me how much humiliation

281The Lord said: “Śrīnivāsa, stop this mockery. All of you together heap humiliation on Me.”59

এত বলি’ লোকে করি’ শুভদৃষ্টি দান ৷
অভ্যন্তরে গেলা, লোকের পূর্ণ হৈল কাম ॥ ২৮২ ॥

eta bali’ loke kari’ śubha-dṛṣṭi dāna
thus saying to the people making of an auspicious glance the gift
abhyantare gelā, lokera pūrṇa haila kāma
inside He went of the people fulfilled became the desire

282Saying this, He bestowed His auspicious glance on the people and went inside, and the people’s desire was fulfilled.

রঘুনাথ-দাস নিত্যানন্দ-পাশে গেলা ৷
চিড়া-দধি-মহোৎসব তাঁহাই করিলা ॥ ২৮৩ ॥

raghunātha-dāsa nityānanda-pāśe gelā
Raghunātha Dāsa to Nityānanda went
ciḍā-dadhi-mahotsava tām̐hāi karilā
the festival of flat rice and yogurt right there held

283Raghunātha dāsa went to Nityānanda and there held the festival of flat rice and yogurt.60

তাঁর আজ্ঞা লঞা গেলা প্রভুর চরণে ৷
প্রভু তাঁরে সমর্পিলা স্বরূপের স্থানে ॥ ২৮৪ ॥

tām̐ra ājñā lañā gelā prabhura caraṇe
His permission taking went to the Lord’s feet
prabhu tām̐re samarpilā svarūpera sthāne
the Lord him entrusted of Svarūpa to the care

284With Nityānanda’s permission he went to the Lord’s feet, and the Lord entrusted him to Svarūpa’s care.61

ব্রহ্মানন্দ-ভারতীর ঘুচাইল চর্ম্মাম্বর ৷
এই মত লীলা কৈল ছয় বৎসর ॥ ২৮৫ ॥

brahmānanda-bhāratīra ghucāila carmāmbara
of Brahmānanda Bhāratī He removed the garment of skin
ei mata līlā kaila chaya vatsara
in this way pastimes He did six years

285He made Brahmānanda Bhāratī give up his garment of skin. In this way He enjoyed His pastimes for six years.

এই ত’ কহিল মধ্যলীলার সূত্রগণ ৷
শেষ দ্বাদশ বৎসরের শুন বিবরণ ॥ ২৮৬ ॥

ei ta’ kahila madhya-līlāra sūtra-gaṇa
this indeed I have told of the Madhya-līlā the sūtras
śeṣa dvādaśa vatsarera śuna vivaraṇa
of the last twelve years hear the account

286Thus I have told the sūtras of the Madhya-līlā. Now hear the account of the last twelve years.62

শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ৷
চৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ২৮৭ ॥

śrī rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
Śrī Rūpa’s, Raghunātha’s at the feet whose hope
caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
“Caitanya-caritāmṛta” narrates Kṛṣṇadāsa

287Praying at the feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate the Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

✦

Notes

  1. The same verse as Ādi 1.2 and 1.84; translation as there.
  2. The same verse as Ādi 1.15; translation as there. Edition heading: “Obeisance to the Deity who presides over sambandha (the relationship with the Lord)”. Anubhāṣya (to Ādi 1.15): manda-mati — “a mind absorbed in the world, feeble, unable to follow other paths such as karma or jñāna”; suratau — “merciful”, or “deeply attached to each other”.
  3. The same verse as Ādi 1.16; translation as there. Edition heading: “Obeisance to the Deity who presides over abhidheya (the means)”. Anubhāṣya (to Ādi 1.16): preṣṭhālī — Lalitā and the other priya-narma-sakhīs, attended by Śrī Rūpa-mañjarī and others.
  4. The same verse as Ādi 1.17; translation as there. Edition heading: “Obeisance to the Deity who presides over prayojana (the goal)”. Anubhāṣya (to Ādi 1.17): the flute “loosens every desire in the gopīs other than for Kṛṣṇa and draws them from their homes with the rope of prema”; śriye — “for the wealth of prema”.
  5. Edition heading (to 11–12): “A promise: the events described in detail in the Caitanya-bhāgavata will be given as sūtras, and the chief events that are told there only briefly will be set out in detail.”
  6. The first line is the same as in Ādi 8.34 and 13.48. Anubhāṣya: Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana Vyāsa wrote of the avatāras and of Kṛṣṇa’s pastimes; Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, who wrote of Śrī Caitanya’s pastimes, is Vyāsa himself (vyāsa-svarūpa); Kṛṣṇadāsa writes of what he left untold as his servant and follower.
  7. The first line is the same as in Ādi 13.12; the second differs there (“now to the south, now to Gauḍa, now to Vṛndāvana”). Setubandha is the site of Rāma’s bridge near Rāmeśvaram (cf. 116).
  8. The first line is the same as in Ādi 13.38; in the second, Ādi 13.38 has laoyāila (“led people to take”), and this verse pravartāila (“spread, established”).
  9. So in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: caitanyera priya yiṅho (“He who is dear to Caitanya”). Other editions read caitanyera bhakti yeṅho (“He who [made the world take] devotion to Caitanya”).
  10. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the Govinda-virudāvalī is part of the Stava-mālā; the Nāṭaka-varṇana is the Nāṭaka-candrikā.
  11. So in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition (bhakti-siddhānta tāte likhiyāchena sāra). Other editions read …dekhāiyāchena pāra (“he has shown the utmost reach of the conclusions of devotion”). Anubhāṣya: the Bhāgavata-sandarbha is also called the Ṣaṭ-sandarbha, the six Sandarbhas.
  12. The verse is also found in the Kāvya-prakāśa (1.4), as the edition heading notes. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya (to 59): it was composed about a worldly hero and heroine; why Mahāprabhu recited it with such love, no one but Svarūpa Dāmodara knew.
  13. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: some readings have uhāi for uṭhi’ (“rising”). Edition heading: “The Lord’s unfeigned affection and mercy towards Rūpa”.
  14. The Gauḍīya Maṭha edition prints saṅgasukham, a misprint that breaks the metre; the Anubhāṣya reads saṅgama-sukham. Anubhāṣya: the flute plays “within — in the depths of the heart, or in the midst of Vṛndā’s forest”.
  15. Anubhāṣya: the gopīs spoke these words to Kṛṣṇa after meeting Him at Kurukṣetra (Syamantapañcaka); gehaṁ juṣām — “of us who dwell at home, in Vṛndāvana, devoted by nature to our household duties”: we are neither yogīs absorbed in meditation nor worldly people, but are sunk in the ocean of separation from You. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: some readings add here another verse, Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 10.83.2.
  16. The pronoun is singular (mora, “My”): these are Rādhikā’s thoughts continued from 78–80, by which Mahāprabhu explains the verse.
  17. Anubhāṣya: Kṛṣṇa offered Śrīmatī Rādhikā any boon She desired, and She answered with this verse; kṣauṇī — the land of Vraja.
  18. Anubhāṣya: Mādhava Purī is Śrī Mādhavendra Purī. Edition heading: “On the way to Purī: the story of Mādhavendra Purī at Remuṇā, and darśana of Gopīnātha”.
  19. The verse does not say who tells the stories: the Lord Himself tells of Kṣīra-corā Gopīnātha (Madhya 4), and Nityānanda of Sākṣi-gopāla (Madhya 5).
  20. Edition heading: “The deliverance of the Buddhist unbelievers, and darśana of Nṛsiṁha at Ahovala”.
  21. Edition heading: “The Lord’s meal at Sārvabhauma’s house; the offence of his son-in-law Amogha, and his deliverance” (Madhya 15).
  22. Edition heading: “The Lord makes arrangements for everyone”.
  23. Edition heading: “The pastimes of the Lord absorbed in the mood of separation (vipralambha)”. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the upavana are the gardens on both sides of the Baḍa-daṇḍa, the road along which the chariot goes to the house of Guṇḍicā.
  24. Anubhāṣya: on the deliverance of Gopāla Cāpala, see Ādi 17.55–59.
  25. Anubhāṣya: Kānāi’s Nāṭaśālā lies about six miles from Rajmahal station (two miles from Taljhari).
  26. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Rāmakeli lies near Gauḍa on the bank of the Gaṅgā; Śrī Rūpa and Sanātana lived there at that time.
  27. Edition heading: “The padishah orders his official not to hinder the Lord from going wherever He wishes”. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya (to 168): the Muslim ruler of Gauḍa was the padishah Husain Shah.
  28. Edition heading: “The kṣatriya Keśava, wishing the Lord well, calms the padishah”. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Keśava knew the truth about Mahāprabhu; fearing that the padishah, if he went on asking, would turn against the Lord, he did not let the conversation go further.
  29. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Dabira Khāsa was the name the Muslim king had given to Śrī Rūpa at that time.
  30. The Gauḍīya Maṭha edition reads vākya siddha haya (“His word comes true”).
  31. Anubhāṣya: of the king it is said, “For a great deity dwells in the form of a man” (Manu-saṁhitā 7.8).
  32. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: just as Śrī Rūpa was then called Dabira Khāsa, Śrī Sanātana was known by the name the king had given him, Sākara Mallika.
  33. Anubhāṣya: the brothers were born in a pure family of Karṇāṭa brāhmaṇas and speak so out of humility: serving a Muslim king, they had taken up the work of low people and so count themselves among them.
  34. Edition heading: the verse is cited in the Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu (Pūrva-vibhāga, Sādhana-bhakti-laharī, 154). Anubhāṣya: parihāre — “when it comes to asking pardon for an offence”; “what shall I say” — I have no ground even to ask.
  35. Edition heading: “By nāmābhāsa alone their sins are burnt and they are delivered”.
  36. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: mlecchas are of two kinds — by birth and by association; the brothers call themselves mlecchas by association, keeping company with those born mlecchas who are hostile to cows and brāhmaṇas.
  37. Anubhāṣya: all worldly enjoyment is of the nature of filth; as one who has fallen into a pit cannot climb out by his own will, so the soul absorbed in sense objects cannot, by his own strength, get out of the pit of worldly enjoyment.
  38. The Gauḍīya Maṭha edition reads sadaya (“Merciful”), with sva-dayā (“Your own mercy”) in brackets; the Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya follows sadaya: “justify Your name sadaya, ‘the merciful’”.
  39. Edition heading: “(a verse by Śrī Yāmunācārya)”; in the edition the verse is printed without a number. Anubhāṣya: being the lowest of all, I am the fit vessel of mercy.
  40. Edition heading: “(a verse by Śrī Yāmunācārya)”.
  41. Edition heading: “The Lord’s merciful words to both brothers, addressed to Śrī Rūpa”.
  42. Anubhāṣya: in His mercy Mahāprabhu named Dabira Khāsa “Rūpa” and Sākara Mallika “Sanātana”; for one on the path of rules the giving of a name is one of the saṁskāras, and those who disregard the name received by the grace of a Vaiṣṇava guru cannot hope for devotion to Hari.
  43. Edition heading: “The outward conduct of a devotee on the path of rāga”, with the note “[a verse spoken by Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya]”. Anubhāṣya: so too expert Vaiṣṇavas outwardly keep the prescribed duties of varṇāśrama, while all the art of their bhajana is service to Hari alone.
  44. Edition heading: “Sanātana gives the Lord good counsel at parting”.
  45. Edition heading: “Though He is the Supreme Lord Himself, in the role of ācārya He gives beginners (kaniṣṭha-adhikārīs) a chance to learn”.
  46. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: in those days a “Kānāi’s Nāṭaśālā” was set up in many places in Gauḍa; here, near Gauḍa, the Lord saw many pictures of Kṛṣṇa’s pastimes.
  47. Edition heading: “The Lord takes leave of all the devotees and tells them to come to Purī for the Ratha-yātrā”.
  48. Anubhāṣya: the twelve forests are Kāmyavana, Tālavana, Tamālavana, Madhuvana, Kusumavana, Bhāṇḍīravana, Bilvavana, Bhadravana, Khadiravana, Lohavana, Kumudavana and Gokula-Mahāvana.
  49. Edition heading: “The Lord sends Sanātana to the Mathurā region and delivers Prakāśānanda”.
  50. Edition heading: “After the six years, the remaining eighteen years — living in Purī alone”.
  51. Edition heading: “Śrī Gadādhara’s vow to stay in the Kṣetra (kṣetra-sannyāsa), and the devotees who lived in Purī”.
  52. The second line is the same as Ādi 10.125. The Gauḍīya Maṭha edition reads bhavānanda: Bhavānanda Rāya, the father of Rāmānanda Rāya.
  53. Anubhāṣya: on the passing of Ṭhākura Haridāsa, see Antya, ch. 11.
  54. Anubhāṣya: this is the infusion of the cit-śakti, the transcendental potency; without it, or when the māyā-śakti is infused, only the inclination to enjoy grows (see Antya, ch. 1).
  55. Anubhāṣya: Dāmodara warned the Lord that the ignorant, not understanding Him, would criticise Him — this is the “punishment by words”; in the devotees’ judgement these are only words that look like punishment (see Antya, chs. 2–3).
  56. Edition heading: “Rāya Rāmānanda, a Vaiṣṇava ācārya though not a brāhmaṇa by birth, is accepted as guru by Pradyumna Miśra, a brāhmaṇa by birth” (see Antya, ch. 5).
  57. Edition heading: “The deliverance of countless living beings of the universe through the sight of the Lord”.
  58. Edition heading (to 269): “The Lord’s reproach and show of anger because Śrīvāsa and the other devotees sing of Gaura, and His order to sing of Kṛṣṇa”.
  59. Edition heading: “The Lord’s embarrassment and His feigned reproach of Śrīvāsa”. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: some manuscripts read instead, “You do all that pains Me.”
  60. Edition heading: “Śrī Raghunātha’s service to Nityānanda and His associates at Pāṇihāṭi”.
  61. Edition heading: “Then, by Nityānanda’s mercy, Raghunātha leaves home, comes to the Lord’s feet in Purī and surrenders himself to Dāmodara Svarūpa”. The Anubhāṣya quotes Raghunātha’s own verse (Vilāpa-kusumāñjali 5): with the ropes of His mercy Caitanya-candra drew him out of the well of household life, brought him to His feet and Himself gave him to Śrī Dāmodara.
  62. Edition heading: “Of the eighteen years, leaving aside six, the pastimes of the last twelve years will be described in sūtras later”. Anubhāṣya: the author gives the sūtras of the last twelve years in the second chapter, and then describes the Madhya- and Antya-līlā step by step in detail (cf. Antya 1.10–11).
